title: A Full List of Current 2026 K-Pop Concerts (Updating)
summary: From aespa and Monsta X to BTS, here's what you can expect from the K-pop concert scene this year.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

More and more, K-pop concerts are becoming a hot topic.

As the genre becomes more popular in the States and across the globe, artists have begun expanding their horizons, taking their tours beyond Asia to stop in North America and beyond. That’s not even including the K-pop acts headlining music festivals or conventions that are going down this year.

On the docket for 2026, we’re already seeing big names embarking on massive world tours and even Las Vegas residencies a la BLACKPINK’s Lisa . BTS, ENHYPEN, IVE and aespa are just a few big names headed out on tour, with more artists announcing tours all the time. To keep you in the know, we’ve compiled a list of K-pop concerts happening in 2026 so far and where you can buy tickets. Keep reading to learn more.
